scripts.build:android: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDirectDebug && mkdir -p ../release && cp app/build/outputs/apk/direct/debug/app-direct-debug.apk "../release/Hamdast-v1.apk" && echo "APK: release/Hamdast-v1.apk"
scripts.apk:bazaar: export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && vite build --mode bazaar && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleBazaarRelease && mkdir -p ../release && VN=$(sed -n 's/.*versionName "\(.*\)".*/\1/p' app/build.gradle | head -1) && cp app/build/outputs/apk/bazaar/release/app-bazaar-release.apk "../release/Hamdast-bazaar-v$VN.apk" && echo "APK: release/Hamdast-bazaar-v$VN.apk"
scripts.apk:myket: export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && vite build --mode myket && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleMyketRelease && mkdir -p ../release && VN=$(sed -n 's/.*versionName "\(.*\)".*/\1/p' app/build.gradle | head -1) && cp app/build/outputs/apk/myket/release/app-myket-release.apk "../release/Hamdast-myket-v$VN.apk" && echo "APK: release/Hamdast-myket-v$VN.apk"
